name: Eraser
description: Generate, create, read, and update diagrams, documents and files in your Eraser workspace directly from Claude. Make Eraser a native part of your AI workflow — describe a system in natural language and have your agent generate a complete diagram, create rich technical docs from code or conversations, and manage files across your workspace. All changes are saved to your Eraser account and accessible from the app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Eraser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Eraser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.eraser.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Eraser MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eraser provides these MCP tools: get, list, search, generate, generateEdit, create, update, delete, export, and selectTeam.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Eraser?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Eraser in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Eraser requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Eraser is developed by Eraser. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
